# Arcane Cut

## Overview
Arcane Cut is one of the most devastating techniques ever developed by the Spellblade Orders. Rather than empowering the blade itself, the Spellblade channels an immense quantity of mana along the weapon's edge before releasing it in a single overwhelming slash. The stored energy erupts from the blade as a massive crescent of arcane force, carving through the battlefield and striking everything caught within its path.

A Spellblade may unleash Arcane Cut as pure Arcane Mana or shape it into one of their mastered magical affinities. Pure Arcane Cuts are exceptionally stable and devastating against magical constructs, summoned creatures, and enchanted barriers, while elemental Arcane Cuts inherit the properties of their chosen element, allowing the attack to ignite, freeze, shock, or otherwise affect their targets.

Unlike Bladestorm, Arcane Cut is a technique of commitment rather than speed. It requires absolute concentration, physical strength, and precise mana control to release a single strike capable of deciding the outcome of an entire battle.

## Rank 1
### Description

Arcane Cut is one of the most devastating techniques ever developed by the Spellblade Orders. Rather than empowering the blade itself, the Spellblade channels an immense quantity of mana along the weapon's edge before releasing it in a single overwhelming slash. The stored energy erupts from the blade as a massive crescent of arcane force, carving through the battlefield and striking everything caught within its path.

A Spellblade may unleash Arcane Cut as pure Arcane Mana or shape it into one of their mastered magical affinities. Pure Arcane Cuts are exceptionally stable and devastating against magical constructs, summoned creatures, and enchanted barriers, while elemental Arcane Cuts inherit the properties of their chosen element, allowing the attack to ignite, freeze, shock, or otherwise affect their targets.

Unlike Bladestorm, Arcane Cut is a technique of commitment rather than speed. It requires absolute concentration, physical strength, and precise mana control to release a single strike capable of deciding the outcome of an entire battle.

### Effects

- Spend **2 Action Points**, **50 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Arcane Cut**.
- Arcane Cut may be used **once per Short Rest**.
- Choose either **Pure Arcane** or one of your known **magical affinities** before releasing the attack.
- Release a **15 metre long, 1 metre wide** wave of mana in a straight line.
- Every creature within the attack's path must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The target suffers your **normal weapon damage** plus an additional **3d10** damage of the chosen damage type.
- **Success:** The target takes **half of all damage**.

#### Arcane Charge

If you do not have **2 available Action Points** during your current turn, you may begin charging Arcane Cut.

- Spend **1 Action Point** to begin charging.
- Your weapon visibly gathers Arcane Mana or your chosen element.
- At the start of your next turn, spend **1 additional Action Point** to immediately release Arcane Cut.
- Mana and Stamina are only spent when the attack is released.

#### Interrupted Charge

If the charge is interrupted before release by being **Disarmed**, **Stunned**, **Unconscious**, your weapon being destroyed or willingly released, or any effect that prevents you from completing the technique:

- Arcane Cut immediately fails.
- The talent use is expended.
- The committed Action Point is lost.
- You lose **50%** of the Mana and Stamina cost as the unstable energy disperses harmlessly.

#### Weapon Conduit

Arcane Cut may only be performed while wielding a melee weapon. The weapon serves as the conduit that shapes and releases the arcane wave. Without it, the technique cannot be completed.

- **Pure Arcane Cuts** are exceptionally effective against magical barriers, magical constructs, summoned creatures, and other magically created objects.
- **Elemental Arcane Cuts** retain the secondary effects of their chosen element where applicable.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Arcane Cut is known as the **First Severance**, the technique that proves a Spellblade's reach extends far beyond the length of their blade. Masters teach that steel is merely the vessel—the true weapon is the mana released from its edge.

Each Spellblade develops a unique Arcane Cut reflecting their magical affinity. Some unleash silent crescents of shimmering mana capable of cleaving enchanted stone, while others release roaring infernos, crashing tides, razor winds, or crackling lightning that embody their elemental mastery. Regardless of its appearance, every Arcane Cut is intended to end the battle with a single perfect strike.

Veterans caution apprentices that the greatest danger is not the attack itself, but the moments spent charging it. An impatient Spellblade releases an incomplete strike. An overconfident one may never release it at all.

> *"Steel begins the cut. Mana carries it. Patience decides whether it reaches its destination."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade has refined Arcane Cut into a far more stable and destructive technique. Greater control over the flow of mana allows the arcane wave to travel farther while maintaining its shape, increasing both its reach and its ability to cleave through multiple opponents. What was once a powerful finishing attack becomes a reliable battlefield technique capable of changing the tide of combat.

As mastery improves, the Spellblade learns to compress mana with even greater precision before its release. Whether formed from pure arcane energy or one of the Spellblade's magical affinities, the resulting wave carries tremendous force as it races across the battlefield, leaving little opportunity for enemies to escape its path.

Despite this growing mastery, Arcane Cut remains a technique demanding patience and commitment. Masters continue to remind their students that every charge leaves them vulnerable, and only those who understand the perfect moment to strike will realise the technique's full potential.

### Effects

- Spend **2 Action Points**, **45 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Arcane Cut**.
- Arcane Cut may be used **2 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose either **Pure Arcane** or one of your known **magical affinities** before releasing the attack.
- Release a **20 metre long, 1.5 metre wide** wave of mana in a straight line.
- Every creature within the attack's path must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The target suffers your **normal weapon damage** plus an additional **4d10** damage of the chosen damage type.
- **Success:** The target takes **half of all damage**.

#### Arcane Charge

If you do not have **2 available Action Points** during your current turn, you may begin charging Arcane Cut.

- Spend **1 Action Point** to begin charging.
- Your weapon gathers Arcane Mana or your chosen magical affinity.
- At the start of your next turn, spend **1 additional Action Point** to immediately release Arcane Cut.
- Mana and Stamina are only spent when the attack is released.

#### Interrupted Charge

If the charge is interrupted before release by being **Disarmed**, **Stunned**, **Unconscious**, your weapon being destroyed or willingly released, or any effect preventing the technique from being completed:

- Arcane Cut immediately fails.
- One use of Arcane Cut is consumed.
- The committed Action Point is lost.
- You lose **50%** of the Mana and Stamina cost as the unstable energy dissipates.

#### Weapon Conduit

Arcane Cut may only be performed while wielding a melee weapon. The weapon acts as the focus through which the arcane wave is shaped and released.

- **Pure Arcane Cuts** deal Arcane Damage and are especially effective against magical barriers, summoned creatures, magical constructs, and other magically created objects.
- **Elemental Arcane Cuts** deal damage matching the chosen affinity and apply any secondary effects associated with that element.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Second Severance**, marking the stage where Arcane Cut evolves from a powerful technique into a dependable battlefield weapon. Spellblades no longer struggle to maintain the arcane wave as it leaves their blade, instead shaping it with enough precision to strike distant foes while preserving its destructive power.

Veterans often describe the technique as a lesson in restraint rather than aggression. Charging Arcane Cut teaches patience, awareness, and discipline, for a poorly timed release wastes both energy and opportunity. Those who master Rank II quickly earn a fearsome reputation, as enemies learn that allowing a Spellblade even a brief moment to prepare can have devastating consequences.

> *"Power gathers in silence. The wise recognise the danger before the blade is ever swung."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

Arcane Cut has evolved into a terrifying display of martial and arcane mastery. The Spellblade's command over mana has become so refined that every slash releases an immense wave of compressed energy capable of carving across the battlefield with incredible force. The expanding arc maintains its structure over far greater distances, making escape increasingly difficult for those caught within its path.

At this level, the Spellblade no longer relies solely upon raw power. Every Arcane Cut is carefully prepared, every movement deliberate, and every release perfectly timed. Whether formed from pure Arcane Mana or one of the Spellblade's elemental affinities, the attack becomes a devastating expression of discipline rather than uncontrolled destruction.

Veteran Spellblades teach that Rank III marks the point where Arcane Cut ceases to be simply an attack. It becomes a battlefield technique capable of forcing enemies to reposition, disrupting formations, and punishing those who underestimate the reach of a Spellblade.

### Effects

- Spend **2 Action Points**, **40 MP**, and **25 SP** to activate **Arcane Cut**.
- Arcane Cut may be used **3 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose either **Pure Arcane** or one of your known **magical affinities** before releasing the attack.
- Release a **25 metre long, 2 metre wide** wave of mana in a straight line.
- Every creature caught within the attack must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The creature suffers your **normal weapon damage** plus an additional **5d10** damage matching the chosen damage type.
- **Success:** The creature takes **half of all damage**.

#### Arcane Charge

If you do not have **2 available Action Points** during your current turn, you may begin charging Arcane Cut.

- Spend **1 Action Point** to begin charging.
- Your weapon gathers Arcane Mana or your chosen magical affinity.
- At the start of your next turn, spend **1 additional Action Point** to release Arcane Cut.
- Mana and Stamina are only spent when the attack is successfully released.

#### Interrupted Charge

If the charge is interrupted by becoming **Disarmed**, **Stunned**, **Unconscious**, your weapon being destroyed or released, or any effect that prevents you from completing the technique:

- Arcane Cut immediately fails.
- One use of Arcane Cut is expended.
- The committed Action Point is lost.
- You lose **50%** of the Mana and Stamina cost as the unstable mana disperses harmlessly.

#### Weapon Conduit

Arcane Cut may only be performed while wielding a melee weapon. The weapon serves as the conduit that shapes and releases the wave of arcane energy.

- **Pure Arcane Cuts** deal Arcane Damage and are highly effective against magical barriers, magical constructs, summoned creatures, and enchanted objects.
- **Elemental Arcane Cuts** deal damage matching the chosen affinity and apply any secondary effects associated with that element.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Battlefield Severance**. It is the point where Arcane Cut becomes feared not for its power alone, but for its ability to reshape the battlefield itself. Entire shield walls have been broken apart by a single perfectly executed strike, forcing enemies to abandon carefully prepared formations.

Masters remind their students that Arcane Cut is never about overwhelming strength. It is about patience, precision, and choosing the exact moment when a single attack will achieve more than a hundred ordinary strikes. Those who master this lesson become warriors capable of ending battles before they truly begin.

To witness a Rank III Arcane Cut is to understand why the Spellblade Orders have long been respected by kings and feared by archmages alike.

> *"A sword may cut a warrior. A perfected Arcane Cut divides the battlefield itself."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

Arcane Cut has become a technique capable of carving through both armies and magic itself. The Spellblade's mastery over mana has reached the point where the arcane wave no longer loses cohesion as it tears across the battlefield. Every slash is compressed into an impossibly dense edge of magical force, capable of cleaving through physical obstacles and lesser magical defences before continuing towards its intended targets.

Whether released as pure Arcane Mana or shaped into one of the Spellblade's elemental affinities, Arcane Cut now carries tremendous destructive force. Entire battle lines have been broken by a single perfectly executed strike, while enemy spellcasters watch their magical barriers split apart beneath the weight of the attack.

Only the greatest Spellblades can safely wield Arcane Cut at this level. The amount of mana compressed into the blade is immense, and even the slightest lapse in concentration can cause the technique to collapse before it is released.

### Effects

- Spend **2 Action Points**, **35 MP**, and **25 SP** to activate **Arcane Cut**.
- Arcane Cut may be used **4 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose either **Pure Arcane** or one of your known **magical affinities** before releasing the attack.
- Release a **30 metre long, 2.5 metre wide** wave of mana in a straight line.
- Every creature within the attack's path must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The creature suffers your **normal weapon damage** plus an additional **6d10** damage matching the chosen damage type.
- **Success:** The creature takes **half of all damage**.

#### Arcane Charge

If you do not have **2 available Action Points** during your current turn, you may begin charging Arcane Cut.

- Spend **1 Action Point** to begin charging.
- Your weapon gathers Arcane Mana or your chosen magical affinity.
- At the start of your next turn, spend **1 additional Action Point** to release Arcane Cut.
- Mana and Stamina are only spent when the attack is successfully released.

#### Interrupted Charge

If the charge is interrupted by becoming **Disarmed**, **Stunned**, **Unconscious**, your weapon being destroyed or willingly released, or any effect preventing the technique from being completed:

- Arcane Cut immediately fails.
- One use of Arcane Cut is expended.
- The committed Action Point is lost.
- You lose **50%** of the Mana and Stamina cost as the unstable mana disperses harmlessly.

#### Weapon Conduit

Arcane Cut may only be performed while wielding a melee weapon. The weapon serves as the focus that shapes and releases the arcane wave.

- **Pure Arcane Cuts** can cleave through **lesser magical barriers, magical constructs, summoned creatures, and enchanted objects** without losing momentum.
- **Elemental Arcane Cuts** deal damage matching the chosen affinity and apply the secondary effects of that element where applicable.
- Arcane Cut ignores **Half Cover** and **Three-Quarters Cover**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Grand Severance**, a title earned only by warriors capable of cutting through the battlefield itself. At this level, Arcane Cut is no longer feared solely for its destructive power, but for its ability to shatter carefully prepared defences. Shield walls, fortified positions, and lesser magical wards offer little protection against a perfectly executed strike.

Veteran masters teach that Rank IV demands absolute patience. The immense concentration of mana required to sustain the attack pushes both body and weapon to their limits, and many promising Spellblades have lost control by attempting to release the technique too early.

Those who master the Grand Severance are spoken of with equal parts admiration and caution, for every witness understands that a single swing of their blade can alter the course of an entire battle.

> *"When steel, mana and purpose become one, even the strongest walls forget they were ever meant to stand."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Cut reaches its ultimate form, becoming one of the legendary techniques of the Spellblade Orders. The Spellblade's mastery over both steel and mana has become so absolute that a single swing can release an immense wave of condensed arcane energy capable of tearing across an entire battlefield. Every strike is the culmination of years of discipline, requiring flawless timing, unwavering concentration, and complete harmony between body, weapon, and mana.

At this level, the Spellblade chooses whether to unleash the attack as pure Arcane Mana or shape it into one of their mastered magical affinities. Pure Arcane Cuts are unrivalled against magical creations, wards, and summoned beings, while elemental Arcane Cuts embody the devastating nature of their chosen element, allowing the Spellblade to tailor the attack to the battlefield before them.

Only the greatest masters are entrusted with this technique. To witness a Rank V Arcane Cut is to see the very air split apart as an overwhelming wave of arcane power races forward, leaving destruction in its wake.

### Effects

- Spend **2 Action Points**, **30 MP**, and **20 SP** to activate **Arcane Cut**.
- Arcane Cut may be used **5 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose either **Pure Arcane** or one of your known **magical affinities** before releasing the attack.
- Release a **40 metre long, 3 metre wide** wave of arcane energy in a straight line.
- Every creature within the attack's path must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The target suffers your **normal weapon damage** plus an additional **8d10** damage of the chosen damage type.
- **Success:** The target takes **half of all damage**.

#### Arcane Charge

If you do not have **2 available Action Points** during your current turn, you may begin charging Arcane Cut.

- Spend **1 Action Point** to begin charging the technique.
- Your weapon becomes engulfed in condensed Arcane Mana or your chosen magical affinity.
- At the start of your next turn, spend **1 additional Action Point** to immediately release Arcane Cut.
- Mana and Stamina are only spent when the technique is successfully released.

#### Interrupted Charge

If the charge is interrupted before release by becoming **Disarmed**, **Stunned**, **Unconscious**, your weapon being destroyed or willingly released, or any effect that prevents the technique from being completed:

- Arcane Cut immediately fails.
- One use of Arcane Cut is expended.
- The committed Action Point is lost.
- You lose **50%** of the Mana and Stamina cost as the unstable energy violently disperses.

#### Weapon Conduit

Arcane Cut may only be performed while wielding a melee weapon. The weapon serves as the conduit that shapes and releases the arcane wave.

- **Pure Arcane Cuts** continue through creatures and may sever **nearly all magical barriers, magical constructs, summoned creatures, enchanted objects, and magical effects**, only being stopped by **Artifact-grade wards, Divine Magic, or World Magic**.
- **Elemental Arcane Cuts** deal damage matching the chosen magical affinity and apply all secondary effects associated with that element where applicable.
- Arcane Cut ignores **Half Cover** and **Three-Quarters Cover**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **World Severance**, a title spoken with reverence by warriors and mages alike. It is said that those who master this technique no longer swing a sword—they command a river of arcane power capable of carving through armies, fortifications, and magical defences with a single flawless motion.

Legends tell of masters who ended sieges by cleaving through enchanted fortress walls, split the attacks of powerful archmages before they reached their allies, and forced entire battalions to scatter before the advancing wave of mana. Yet every tale shares the same lesson: the technique is not born from overwhelming power alone, but from perfect patience and unwavering discipline.

To master Arcane Cut is to embody the highest ideals of the Spellblade Orders. Steel becomes the guide, mana becomes the blade, and the impossible becomes only another obstacle waiting to be severed.

> *"When your blade no longer ends at its edge, the battlefield itself becomes your reach."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

# Arcane Dominion

## Overview
Arcane Dominion is one of the highest disciplines practiced by the Spellblade Orders, allowing the Spellblade to claim a portion of the battlefield as their own. By plunging their weapon into the ground or focusing its point before them, they release a surge of arcane energy that spreads across the surrounding area, creating a Dominion where the natural flow of mana bends to their will.

Within this territory, the Spellblade's mastery over both swordsmanship and magic reaches its peak. Mana answers their commands more readily, while hostile spellcasters find their own magic becoming unstable and increasingly difficult to control. Every movement, every spell, and every strike is influenced by the Dominion's overwhelming arcane pressure.

Although incredibly powerful, maintaining a Dominion demands immense concentration and a tremendous amount of mana. Masters teach that the ability should only be invoked when the outcome of a battle hangs in the balance.

## Rank 1
### Description

Arcane Dominion is one of the highest disciplines practiced by the Spellblade Orders, allowing the Spellblade to claim a portion of the battlefield as their own. By plunging their weapon into the ground or focusing its point before them, they release a surge of arcane energy that spreads across the surrounding area, creating a Dominion where the natural flow of mana bends to their will.

Within this territory, the Spellblade's mastery over both swordsmanship and magic reaches its peak. Mana answers their commands more readily, while hostile spellcasters find their own magic becoming unstable and increasingly difficult to control. Every movement, every spell, and every strike is influenced by the Dominion's overwhelming arcane pressure.

Although incredibly powerful, maintaining a Dominion demands immense concentration and a tremendous amount of mana. Masters teach that the ability should only be invoked when the outcome of a battle hangs in the balance.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **80 MP** to activate **Arcane Dominion**.
- Arcane Dominion lasts for **3 Turns**.
- **1 Use per Short Rest.**
- Create a **10 metre radius** Arcane Dominion centred on yourself. The Dominion moves with you.

While inside your Arcane Dominion:

#### You gain:

- **+2** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- **+2** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Regain **10 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Regain **5 SP** at the start of each of your turns.

#### Enemy creatures gain:

- **Disadvantage** on Concentration Checks.
- **-2** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Mana restoration is reduced by **50%** while inside the Dominion.

Only one Arcane Dominion may exist at a time.

### Lore

Among the oldest Spellblade Orders, Arcane Dominion is known as the **Master's Circle**, a technique reserved for those whose understanding of mana extends beyond their own body. Rather than merely controlling the magic within themselves, the Spellblade learns to influence the magical currents surrounding them, shaping the battlefield into an extension of their own will.

Those who witness the technique often describe the air itself changing. Arcane runes shimmer across the ground, the atmosphere vibrates with restrained magical energy, and even seasoned spellcasters find their magic becoming sluggish beneath the Dominion's oppressive influence.

Veterans teach that a true Spellblade never seeks to control the entire battlefield. Instead, they create a single place where victory becomes inevitable.

> *"Do not chase the battle. Make the battle come to you."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's understanding of Arcane Dominion has deepened, allowing them to establish a larger and more stable zone of arcane influence. Rather than simply empowering themselves, the Spellblade begins manipulating the very flow of mana across the battlefield, creating an area where allies flourish and enemy spellcasters struggle to maintain control.

Experienced Spellblades no longer create their Dominion beneath their own feet. Instead, they project it onto the battlefield, placing it exactly where it will have the greatest tactical impact. Whether protecting allies, controlling an objective, or denying enemy mages access to stable mana, every Dominion becomes a carefully planned extension of the Spellblade's strategy.

Veterans often describe Arcane Dominion as an invisible fortress. While walls cannot be seen, every creature entering the area immediately feels the overwhelming presence of disciplined arcane energy pressing against them.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **75 MP** to activate **Arcane Dominion**.
- Arcane Dominion lasts for **4 Turns**.
- **2 Uses per Short Rest.**
- Place an **Arcane Dominion** anywhere within **20 metres**.
- The Dominion creates a **12 metre radius** stationary zone and does **not** move once created.
- Only one Arcane Dominion may exist at a time.

#### Allied Creatures inside the Dominion

- Gain **+2** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+2** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Recover **15 MP** at the start of their turn.
- Recover **10 SP** at the start of their turn.
- Gain **Advantage** on Concentration Checks.

#### Enemy Creatures inside the Dominion

- Suffer **-2** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Have **Disadvantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**.
- Teleportation and dimensional movement into or out of the Dominion requires a successful **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**. On a failure, the effect is cancelled but the resources spent are still consumed.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Commander's Dominion**, marking the point where the battlefield itself begins responding to the Spellblade's presence. Rather than merely strengthening themselves, accomplished Spellblades learn to reshape the magical currents around an entire area, turning favourable ground into an overwhelming strategic advantage.

Military commanders have long sought the support of Spellblades capable of establishing a Dominion. Entire battles have been won simply because allied forces fought within its protective influence while enemy mages found their spells weakened and unreliable. Many armies now consider a veteran Spellblade as valuable as an entire company of elite soldiers.

Masters teach that Arcane Dominion is not simply a display of magical power—it is an expression of battlefield leadership. A wise Spellblade does not chase victory. They create a place where victory naturally follows.

> *"A battlefield belongs to whoever commands its flow. Arcane Dominion ensures that flow is yours."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

Arcane Dominion has evolved into a true nexus of arcane power. The Spellblade no longer simply creates an area of magical influence—they reshape the battlefield itself, drawing surrounding mana into a stable domain where every action is influenced by their mastery. Within this territory, allies fight with renewed confidence while enemy spellcasters struggle against an oppressive tide of arcane resistance.

The Dominion is no longer merely a defensive technique. Veteran Spellblades deliberately establish their Dominion before a battle begins, forcing opponents to either fight on unfavourable ground or surrender valuable territory. Every movement within the Dominion is dictated by the Spellblade's overwhelming control over the surrounding mana currents.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is regarded as the point where the Dominion becomes an extension of its creator. Allies instinctively rally within its borders, while enemies quickly learn that remaining inside the Dominion only strengthens the Spellblade's advantage.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **70 MP** to activate **Arcane Dominion**.
- Arcane Dominion lasts for **5 Turns**.
- **3 Uses per Short Rest.**
- Place an **Arcane Dominion** anywhere within **25 metres**.
- The Dominion creates a **15 metre radius** stationary zone.
- Only one Arcane Dominion may exist at a time.

#### Allied Creatures inside the Dominion

- Gain **+3** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+3** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Recover **20 MP** at the start of their turn.
- Recover **15 SP** at the start of their turn.
- Gain **Advantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Increase the range of **Spells**, **Arcane Cut**, and other ranged magical attacks by **5 metres** while cast from within the Dominion.

#### Enemy Creatures inside the Dominion

- Suffer **-3** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Have **Disadvantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Mana regeneration is reduced by **75%**.
- Teleportation and dimensional movement into or out of the Dominion requires a successful **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**. On a failure, the effect is cancelled and all resources spent are still consumed.
- Ranged magical attacks originating from within the Dominion have their maximum range reduced by **5 metres**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Arcane Nexus**. It represents the moment a Spellblade ceases to merely influence the battlefield and instead begins controlling it. Every thread of mana flowing through the Dominion bends towards the Spellblade's will, empowering allies while resisting hostile magic.

Many famous battles throughout Asteria have been won not through superior numbers, but through the careful placement of an Arcane Nexus. Enemy commanders often find themselves forced to abandon favourable positions simply to escape its overwhelming influence, while allied forces fight with renewed determination beneath the Dominion's protective embrace.

Masters teach that the battlefield itself is a weapon. The greatest Spellblades do not overpower their enemies through strength alone—they create a battlefield where victory becomes the only possible outcome.

> *"Master your blade, then your mana. One day you will master the ground beneath your enemies' feet."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

Arcane Dominion has evolved into one of the greatest battlefield techniques known to the Spellblade Orders. No longer content with merely empowering allies and suppressing enemy magic, the Spellblade now commands the very flow of arcane energy throughout the Dominion. Every current of mana bends towards their will, allowing them to influence battles far beyond the reach of their blade.

Within the Dominion, the Spellblade becomes the unquestioned master of the battlefield. Every ally benefits from the stabilising currents of mana, while enemy spellcasters find their magic becoming increasingly unstable. - Have **Disadvantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Mana regeneration is prevented while inside the Dominion.

While standing inside your Arcane Dominion, you may originate compatible **Spellblade Talents** from **any point within the Dominion** instead of your own position.

Examples include:

- Arcane Cut
- Spellbreaker
- Arcane Rush
- Arcane Pursuit

The chosen talent is treated as though it originated from that location.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Master's Dominion**. It is the point where the battlefield itself becomes an extension of the Spellblade's mind. Veteran masters no longer fight from a single position. Instead, they command every corner of their Dominion as though they were physically standing there, making it nearly impossible for enemies to predict where the next attack will come from.

Stories tell of Spellblades defending entire bridges, castle gates and mountain passes alone, not because they were stronger than their enemies, but because every inch of ground within their Dominion belonged to them. Enemy commanders often realised too late that entering the Dominion meant accepting the Spellblade's rules of engagement.

To achieve the Master's Dominion is to understand that true victory is not earned through overwhelming strength, but through absolute control of the battlefield itself.

> *"Do not ask where the Spellblade stands. Ask where their Dominion ends."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Dominion reaches its ultimate form, becoming the pinnacle of battlefield manipulation within the Spellblade Orders. The Spellblade no longer influences the flow of mana—they command it. Every current of magical energy bends to their will, transforming a vast section of the battlefield into territory where allies flourish and enemies find their magic weakened beneath overwhelming arcane pressure.

Within the Dominion, the Spellblade's mastery extends beyond their own position. Their awareness of every arcane current allows them to direct attacks, reinforce allies, and suppress hostile spellcasters with unmatched precision. To fight within a master's Dominion is to battle on ground where the Spellblade dictates the rules of engagement.

Only a handful of Spellblades throughout history have achieved this level of mastery. Entire armies have been forced to abandon strategic positions rather than challenge a fully established Dominion, earning its masters the title of battlefield architects.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **60 MP** to activate **Arcane Dominion**.
- Arcane Dominion lasts for **8 Turns**.
- **5 Uses per Short Rest.**
- Place an Arcane Dominion anywhere within **35 metres**.
- The Dominion creates a **20 metre radius** stationary zone.
- Only one Arcane Dominion may exist at a time.

#### Allied Creatures inside the Dominion

- Gain **+4** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+4** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Recover **30 MP** at the start of their turn.
- Recover **20 SP** at the start of their turn.
- Gain **Advantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Increase the range of spells and magical abilities by **10 metres** while cast from within the Dominion.

#### Enemy Creatures inside the Dominion

- Suffer **-4** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Have **Disadvantage** on Concentration Checks.
- Cannot naturally regenerate Mana while inside the Dominion.
- Teleportation, dimensional travel and similar magical movement require a successful **Wisdom Saving Throw** against your **Spellblade Save DC**. On a failure, the effect is cancelled and all resources spent are still consumed.
- Magical barriers, summoned creatures and magical constructs within the Dominion have reduced magical resilience at the GM's discretion.

#### Arcane Conduit

While standing inside your Arcane Dominion, you may originate compatible Spellblade Talents from **any point within the Dominion** instead of your own position.

Examples include:

- Arcane Cut
- Spellbreaker
- Arcane Rush
- Arcane Pursuit

#### Dominion Mastery

Once per turn, you may spend **1 Action Point** to relocate your entire Arcane Dominion up to **10 metres** in any direction. All effects immediately move with the Dominion.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Grand Dominion**. Masters who reach this stage no longer fight as individuals; they command the battlefield itself. Every rune, every current of mana and every movement within the Dominion becomes part of an intricate design known only to its creator.

Legends tell of Grand Dominion Masters holding bridges against entire armies, silencing circles of archmages, and turning hopeless battles into decisive victories simply by controlling where the fight would take place. Their enemies quickly learn that strength alone means little when every step is taken within the Spellblade's domain.

The highest lesson of Arcane Dominion is simple: victory belongs not to the strongest warrior, but to the one who decides where the battle is fought.

> *"Master your blade, command your mana, and one day even the battlefield will answer your call."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

# Arcane Catalyst

## Overview
Arcane Catalyst is one of the most closely guarded techniques of the Spellblade Orders. Rather than drawing mana from within themselves alone, the Spellblade temporarily becomes a living conduit through which the surrounding arcane currents naturally flow. Every spell becomes easier to shape, every weapon strike carries greater magical force, and the connection between blade and mana reaches an extraordinary level of harmony.

As the Catalyst awakens, brilliant streams of arcane energy spiral around the Spellblade, continuously feeding their Arcane Weapon and reinforcing every technique they perform. The air shimmers with unstable magical energy as mana is drawn from the environment itself before being refined into perfectly controlled power.

Unlike Avatar of the Blade, Arcane Catalyst is not about overwhelming strength. It is about absolute efficiency, allowing the Spellblade to accomplish far more with every point of mana they expend.

## Rank 1
### Description

Arcane Catalyst is one of the most closely guarded techniques of the Spellblade Orders. Rather than drawing mana from within themselves alone, the Spellblade temporarily becomes a living conduit through which the surrounding arcane currents naturally flow. Every spell becomes easier to shape, every weapon strike carries greater magical force, and the connection between blade and mana reaches an extraordinary level of harmony.

As the Catalyst awakens, brilliant streams of arcane energy spiral around the Spellblade, continuously feeding their Arcane Weapon and reinforcing every technique they perform. The air shimmers with unstable magical energy as mana is drawn from the environment itself before being refined into perfectly controlled power.

Unlike Avatar of the Blade, Arcane Catalyst is not about overwhelming strength. It is about absolute efficiency, allowing the Spellblade to accomplish far more with every point of mana they expend.

### Effects

Spend **1 Action Point** and **100 MP** to activate **Arcane Catalyst**.

Arcane Catalyst lasts for **5 Turns**.

**1 Use per Long Rest.**

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- All Spellblade Talent Mana Costs are reduced by **25%** (minimum 1 MP).
- Recover **25 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain **+2** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+2** to Spellblade Save DC.
- Arcane Edge remains active without paying its upkeep cost.
- Arcane Arsenal gains **+1d6** magical damage.
- Arcane Cut deals an additional **1d10** damage.
- Spellbreaker gains **+2** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Dominion restores an additional **10 MP** to allies inside the Dominion.

When Arcane Catalyst ends:

- Gain **Mana Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- During Mana Fatigue, your Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Arcane Catalyst is known as the **Living Conduit**, representing complete mastery over the movement of mana itself. Rather than forcing mana to obey, the Spellblade learns to guide it naturally, allowing arcane energy to pass effortlessly through their body before being shaped into devastating techniques.

Only the greatest masters can maintain this delicate balance. Too little control causes the surrounding mana to disperse harmlessly, while too much force risks catastrophic feedback capable of injuring the Spellblade from within. Those who succeed become living nexuses of magical energy, their presence alone strengthening the flow of mana around them.

Legends speak of masters who fought for hours without exhausting their reserves, each spell flowing into the next with effortless precision. To witness Arcane Catalyst is to see mana itself willingly answer the call of a true Spellblade.

> *"Power is not found in how much mana you possess... but in how perfectly you allow it to flow."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's understanding of Arcane Catalyst has matured, allowing them to refine the flow of mana with remarkable precision. Every spell, every technique, and every weapon enhancement is executed with minimal waste, enabling the Spellblade to sustain their most demanding abilities for extended periods without exhausting their reserves.

As Arcane Catalyst awakens, streams of magical energy continuously circulate around the Spellblade before flowing back into their body, creating a near-perfect cycle of mana. Their Arcane Weapon shines brighter, their spells become easier to control, and every technique feels lighter to perform. Veteran Spellblades describe the sensation as though the world itself is willingly lending them its mana.

While still requiring tremendous focus, Rank II transforms Arcane Catalyst from a powerful enhancement into a reliable source of sustained magical supremacy, allowing the Spellblade to dominate prolonged engagements where other mages would quickly exhaust themselves.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **90 MP** to activate **Arcane Catalyst**.
- Arcane Catalyst lasts for **6 Turns**.
- **2 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- All Spellblade Talent Mana Costs are reduced by **35%** (minimum 1 MP).
- Recover **35 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain **+3** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+3** to your Spellblade Save DC.
- Arcane Edge remains active without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal gains an additional **+1d6** magical damage.
- Arcane Cut deals an additional **2d10** damage.
- Spellbreaker gains **+3** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Dominion restores an additional **15 MP** to allied creatures within its area.
- Mystic Recovery restores **25%** additional HP, SP or MP while Arcane Catalyst is active.

#### Mana Conduit

While Arcane Catalyst is active, whenever you successfully defeat a hostile creature or successfully counter a spell using **Spellbreaker**, immediately recover **15 MP**.

When Arcane Catalyst ends:

- Gain **Mana Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- During Mana Fatigue, Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Flowing Conduit**. Masters teach that true magical strength is not measured by the size of one's Mana Pool, but by the efficiency with which every fragment of mana is used. Those who achieve this state appear tireless, maintaining devastating techniques long after other warriors and mages have exhausted themselves.

Veterans often describe the Flowing Conduit as a living river of mana. Every spell cast, every weapon strike, and every technique naturally feeds into the next, creating an endless rhythm that few opponents can withstand. Watching a master fight is like witnessing a current that never stops flowing—relentless, graceful, and impossible to interrupt.

To master Rank II is to learn that the greatest source of power is not limitless mana, but the wisdom to never waste it.

> *"A single drop of mana, perfectly placed, outweighs an ocean cast without purpose."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

Arcane Catalyst has evolved beyond simple efficiency, transforming the Spellblade into a living nexus through which vast currents of mana naturally flow. Every spell cast, every technique performed, and every strike delivered becomes part of an unbroken cycle of arcane energy. Rather than consuming mana alone, the Spellblade continuously refines and recycles it, dramatically reducing waste while empowering every technique.

The Spellblade's chosen magical affinity radiates from their body in waves, surrounding them with an ever-changing aura of concentrated mana. Their Arcane Weapon hums with overwhelming magical power, and even experienced mages can feel the surrounding arcane currents bending toward the Catalyst's presence.

Masters of the Spellblade Orders describe Rank III as the point where a Spellblade no longer forces mana to obey. Instead, mana willingly gathers around them, recognising them as a perfect conduit through which it may safely flow.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **80 MP** to activate **Arcane Catalyst**.
- Arcane Catalyst lasts for **7 Turns**.
- **3 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- All **Spellblade Talent Mana Costs** are reduced by **50%** (minimum 1 MP).
- Recover **45 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain **+4** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+4** to your Spellblade Save DC.
- Arcane Edge remains active without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal gains an additional **+2d6** magical damage.
- Arcane Cut deals an additional **2d10** damage.
- Spellbreaker gains **+4** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Dominion restores an additional **20 MP** to allied creatures within its area.
- Mystic Recovery restores **50%** additional HP, SP or MP while Arcane Catalyst is active.

#### Arcane Overflow

Whenever you successfully:

- Defeat a hostile creature,
- Successfully counter a spell using **Spellbreaker**, or
- Restore HP, MP or SP using **Mystic Recovery**,

Immediately recover **25 MP**.

This effect may trigger **once per turn**.

When Arcane Catalyst ends:

- Gain **Mana Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- During Mana Fatigue, your natural Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**, and Spellblade Talents cost **25% more MP**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Living Nexus**. Few Spellblades ever achieve this level of mastery, for it requires absolute harmony between body, blade, and mana. Those who succeed become walking centres of magical energy, drawing mana from the world around them and refining it with extraordinary efficiency.

Legends speak of Living Nexus masters continuing to fight long after entire battalions of mages had exhausted their reserves. Every spell seemed to fuel the next, every technique flowed effortlessly into another, and every strike strengthened the Spellblade instead of weakening them. To fight alongside such a master was to witness mana itself choosing its champion.

The Living Nexus is revered as proof that true mastery lies not in possessing limitless power, but in ensuring that no fragment of power is ever wasted.

> *"Mana is never truly spent. The wise simply learn how to make it return."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

Arcane Catalyst has reached a level where the Spellblade no longer relies solely upon the mana within their own body. Instead, they become a living conduit capable of drawing upon the surrounding arcane currents, weaving environmental mana into every strike, spell, and technique. Their presence alone alters the magical landscape, strengthening allies while destabilising hostile magic.

The Spellblade's chosen magical affinity radiates in brilliant waves, surrounding them with an ever-shifting mantle of arcane energy. Every movement leaves shimmering trails of mana behind, and every Spellblade technique flows together without interruption. Even veteran mages can feel the surrounding mana responding instinctively to the Catalyst's presence.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Grand Catalyst**, a title reserved for those whose mastery allows them to command not only their own mana, but the mana of the battlefield itself.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **70 MP** to activate **Arcane Catalyst**.
- Arcane Catalyst lasts for **8 Turns**.
- **4 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- All **Spellblade Talent Mana Costs** are reduced by **50%** (minimum 1 MP).
- Recover **60 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain **+5** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+5** to your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- Arcane Edge remains active without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal gains an additional **+2d6** magical damage.
- Arcane Cut deals an additional **3d10** damage.
- Spellbreaker gains **+5** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Dominion restores an additional **25 MP** to allied creatures within its area.
- Mystic Recovery restores **75%** additional HP, SP or MP while Arcane Catalyst is active.

#### Arcane Convergence

While standing within your **Arcane Dominion**, your first Spellblade Talent used each turn costs **0 MP**.

#### Arcane Overflow

Once per turn, whenever you:

- Defeat a hostile creature.
- Successfully counter a spell with **Spellbreaker**.
- Restore resources using **Mystic Recovery**.

Recover **35 MP** immediately.

#### Mana Mastery

During Arcane Catalyst, your Spellblade Talents cannot suffer **Mana Feedback**, **Spell Feedback**, or similar effects caused by insufficient mana or unstable mana flow.

When Arcane Catalyst ends:

- Gain **Mana Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- During Mana Fatigue:
  - Natural Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**.
  - Spellblade Talents cost **25% more MP**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Grand Catalyst**, a title earned by only a handful of masters throughout history. At this stage, the Spellblade ceases to be merely a wielder of mana and instead becomes one of its greatest conductors. The surrounding magical currents willingly flow towards them, reinforcing every spell and every swing of their weapon.

Ancient accounts describe Grand Catalysts walking through battlefields where allied mages found their spells strengthened simply by fighting nearby, while hostile spellcasters struggled to maintain even the simplest incantations beneath the overwhelming pressure of the Catalyst's presence.

The greatest masters teach that true magical supremacy is not achieved by possessing endless mana, but by ensuring that every fragment of mana serves a purpose.

> *"The greatest conduit is not the one that holds the most power... but the one through which no power is ever wasted."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Catalyst reaches its final evolution, transforming the Spellblade into the ultimate conduit of arcane power. Mana no longer feels like a finite resource but a living force flowing through every movement, every strike and every spell. The Spellblade no longer expends magic inefficiently—instead, they guide it with perfect precision, ensuring every fragment of mana fulfils its purpose before returning to the endless currents of the world.

As the Catalyst reaches its peak, the Spellblade's chosen affinity surrounds them in an overwhelming display of magical energy. Their Arcane Weapon pulses with incredible power, the air hums with condensed mana, and nearby spellcasters instinctively recognise that they stand in the presence of one who has mastered magic itself.

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Infinite Catalyst**. It is regarded as the highest achievement of magical discipline, proving that limitless power is not created through endless mana, but through flawless control over every drop that is used.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **60 MP** to activate **Arcane Catalyst**.
- Arcane Catalyst lasts for **10 Turns**.
- **5 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- All **Spellblade Talent Mana Costs** are reduced by **50%** (minimum **1 MP**).
- Recover **75 MP** at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain **+6** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+6** to your **Spellblade Save DC**.
- Arcane Edge remains active without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal gains an additional **+3d6** magical damage.
- Arcane Cut deals an additional **3d10** damage.
- Spellbreaker gains **+6** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Dominion restores an additional **30 MP** to allied creatures within its area.
- Mystic Recovery restores **100%** additional HP, SP or MP while Arcane Catalyst is active.

#### Infinite Catalyst

Once per turn, the **first Spellblade Talent** you activate costs **0 MP**.

If you are standing within your **Arcane Dominion**, the first **two Spellblade Talents** you activate each turn cost **0 MP**.

#### Arcane Overflow

Once per turn, whenever you:

- Defeat a hostile creature.
- Successfully counter a spell using **Spellbreaker**.
- Restore HP, SP or MP using **Mystic Recovery**.

Recover **50 MP**.

Excess Mana restored while Arcane Catalyst is active may temporarily exceed your normal Maximum MP by **20%**. This excess Mana disappears when Arcane Catalyst ends.

#### Mana Mastery

While Arcane Catalyst is active:

- You cannot suffer **Mana Feedback**, **Spell Feedback**, or **Mana Burn** caused by your own Spellblade Talents.
- Your Spellblade Talents cannot have their Mana Costs increased by enemy effects.
- Your Mana cannot be drained by magical effects unless they originate from **Artifact**, **Divine**, or **World Magic**.

When Arcane Catalyst ends:

- Gain **Mana Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- During Mana Fatigue:
  - Natural Mana regeneration is reduced by **50%**.
  - Spellblade Talents cost **25%** more MP.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, the Infinite Catalyst is considered the final lesson of magical mastery. It is said that those who reach this state cease to think about mana entirely. Every spell, every technique and every movement becomes instinctive, guided by an understanding so complete that the world's own arcane currents willingly answer their call.

Ancient chronicles describe Infinite Catalysts standing beside exhausted armies of mages, continuing to weave spell after spell while their reserves seemed impossible to deplete. Many believed they possessed limitless mana, yet the truth was far more remarkable—they simply wasted none.

The Infinite Catalyst is not remembered as the Spellblade with the greatest Mana Pool, but as the one who demonstrated that perfect control will always surpass limitless power.

> *"The fool seeks more mana. The master seeks to waste none."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack** while Avatar of the Blade is active.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Perfect Avatar**. It is said that this is the point where a Spellblade no longer commands mana—it willingly answers every command before the thought is fully formed. Their blade moves with impossible speed, their magic flows without hesitation, and every technique reaches heights thought unattainable by ordinary masters.

Ancient texts tell of Perfect Avatars standing alone against impossible odds, effortlessly weaving swordsmanship and magic together until even veteran archmages struggled to distinguish where steel ended and mana began. Those fortunate enough to witness the transformation often claim that the Spellblade no longer appears mortal, but instead resembles a living incarnation of their chosen magical affinity.

The Perfect Avatar is not simply stronger than an ordinary Spellblade. It is the embodiment of everything the Spellblade Orders have spent centuries striving to achieve—a warrior whose body, weapon and mana exist in complete harmony.

> *"When your blade no longer follows your hand, but your very soul, the Avatar has become complete."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Avatar of the Blade has become an almost divine manifestation of martial and arcane perfection. Upon awakening the Avatar, the Spellblade enters a state where every strike, every spell, and every movement becomes effortless. Their body is no longer constrained by the hesitation of mortal thought, allowing them to fight with flawless precision and impossible speed.

The Spellblade radiates overwhelming arcane power, their chosen magical affinity engulfing both their body and Arcane Arsenal. Every step leaves shimmering traces of mana, while every swing appears capable of cutting both steel and magic alike. To those who witness it, the Avatar resembles an ancient guardian forged from blade and arcane energy rather than flesh and blood.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is regarded as the threshold of legend. Those capable of maintaining this form are said to have mastered every lesson their Order can teach, becoming living examples of perfect harmony between swordsmanship and magic.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **120 MP**, and **35 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **6 Turns**.
- **4 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains an additional **+3d6** damage.
- Gain **+5** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+5** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **25 metres**.
- Arcane Edge costs **no Mana**.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an Action Point.
- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if you have **2 Action Points** available.
- Spellbreaker gains **+5** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase costs **no Mana** to activate.
- Arcane Dominion increases its radius by **10 metres**, and compatible Spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the Dominion.

#### Avatar Mastery

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Spellblade talents ignore effects that would normally interrupt their activation unless you become **Unconscious**.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- You gain **Advantage** on all Concentration Checks.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Ascendant Avatar**. Very few Spellblades ever reach this state, for it demands not only unmatched martial skill but complete unity with one's mana. Masters describe the transformation as becoming the perfect expression of the Order's ideals, where every action is instinctive and every technique flows together without conscious thought.

Legends tell of Ascendant Avatars walking unharmed through storms of magic, reshaping their weapons in the blink of an eye, and answering every attack with flawless precision. To allies they inspire absolute confidence. To enemies they represent the terrifying realisation that they are no longer fighting a mortal warrior, but the living incarnation of the Spellblade's ancient traditions.

To achieve the Ascendant Avatar is to prove that mastery is not measured by power alone, but by absolute control over every aspect of one's blade, body, and soul.

> *"The Avatar is not awakened by power. It is awakened when there is no longer any difference between the warrior, the blade, and the mana that binds them together."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Avatar of the Blade reaches its ultimate form, transforming the Spellblade into the perfect union of warrior and mage. No longer merely wielding steel or commanding mana, the Spellblade becomes the living embodiment of both. Every movement flows with impossible precision, every spell is cast without hesitation, and every strike carries the overwhelming authority of a true master.

As the Avatar awakens, the Spellblade is engulfed by an immense aura of their chosen magical affinity. Their Arcane Arsenal shines with legendary brilliance, the battlefield itself trembling beneath the pressure of condensed mana. To allies, the Avatar inspires unwavering courage. To enemies, it is a terrifying reminder that they face someone who has surpassed the limits of mortal mastery.

Only the greatest Spellblades in history have ever achieved this transformation. Their names are remembered not for the battles they fought, but for the impossible victories they made appear effortless.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **100 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **8 Turns**.
- **5 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains **+3d6** additional damage.
- Gain **+6** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+6** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **30 metres**.
- Gain **Advantage** on all Concentration Checks.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- Arcane Edge costs **no Mana**.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an Action Point.
- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if both required Action Points are available.
- Spellbreaker gains **+6** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase costs **no Mana** to activate.
- Arcane Dominion gains **+10 metres** radius, and compatible Spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the Dominion.

#### Perfect Harmony

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- All **Spellblade Talents** cost **50% less Mana** (minimum cost of 1 MP).
- **Once per turn**, after using a Spellblade Talent, you may activate a **different Spellblade Talent** without paying its Mana Cost. Normal Action Point costs still apply.
- Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to **0 HP**, immediately recover **20 MP** and **10 SP**.

#### Avatar's End

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- Arcane Fatigue reduces your Movement Speed by **5 metres** and prevents the activation of **Avatar of the Blade** again until the current cooldown has been refreshed.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known simply as **The Eternal Avatar**. It is the final lesson taught only through legend, for no master can truly instruct another how to achieve it. The transformation is said to occur only when a Spellblade has completely abandoned the distinction between blade, body and mana, allowing all three to exist as a single perfect expression of their will.

Stories speak of Eternal Avatars standing alone against dragons, breaking the spells of archmages with a single swing, and defending entire kingdoms through unmatched mastery rather than overwhelming force. Every technique they had ever learned flowed together seamlessly, each becoming stronger because of the others. Their enemies often believed they fought many warriors at once, unable to comprehend that every impossible feat came from a single Spellblade.

The Eternal Avatar is regarded as the highest achievement of the Order—not because it grants unmatched power, but because it represents perfect balance. Steel without magic is incomplete. Magic without steel is uncontrolled. Together, they become something worthy of legend.

> *"When there is no longer a difference between your blade, your magic, and your soul... you have become the Avatar."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well
